_: English for src/core/detail.js: the symbolic stars (神煞) and their meanings, the relations between stems and branches (刑沖合害), the palaces, the Tai Sui spirits. Keyed by the Chinese as written there. Shared BaZi terms are in bazi-terms.json.

story.祖上、童年的家境: your ancestors and the family circumstances of your childhood
story.父母兄弟、成長環境與事業的根基（月令）: parents, siblings, your upbringing and the foundations of your career (the month branch)
story.子女、晚輩與晚年: children, the younger generation and later life
story.{a}與{b}半合{el}局: {a} and {b} form a half combination of {el}
story.流年與大運同為{name}（歲運並臨）: the year and the Luck Pillar are both {name} (year and Luck Pillar alike)
story.{who}{name}與{pillar}相同（伏吟）: the {who} {name} repeats your {pillar} (Fu Yin, a repeating pillar)
story.{who}{name}與{pillar}{other}天剋地沖（反吟）: the {who} {name} opposes your {pillar} {other}, stem against stem and branch against branch (Fan Yin, an opposing pillar)
story.最尊貴的吉神，遇到困難時容易有人伸出援手，逢凶化吉: the noblest lucky star: when trouble comes, someone tends to lend a hand, turning bad luck into good
story.聰明好學，對哲學、宗教、玄學有悟性: clever and studious, with a feel for philosophy, religion and the metaphysical
story.聰明、文筆好，利於讀書、考試與文職: clever, with a good way with words; good for study, exams and office work
story.做事有原則、守信用，適合公職或掌管印信的職務: principled and true to your word, suited to public service or posts in charge of official seals
story.一生多福氣，衣食不缺: a well-blessed life, never short of food or clothing
story.有口福，懂得享受生活，也可能善於烹調: fond of good food and good at enjoying life, perhaps a fine cook too
story.日主的長生之地，聰明好學，學習能力強: where the Day Master is born in the life cycle: clever, studious and quick to learn
story.有自己的俸祿與根基，工作和收入較穩定: a livelihood and foundation of your own, with steadier work and income
story.像坐上金車，生活較富足，也常得配偶助力: like riding in a golden carriage: a comfortable life, often with help from your spouse
story.上天的庇佑，一生少災，遇事容易轉圜: heaven's protection: few disasters in life, and a way round trouble
story.月中的福德，性情溫和，遇難易解: the month's blessing: a mild temper, and troubles easily resolved
story.天德的合神，作用和天德相近而稍弱: the partner of Heavenly Virtue, working like it but a little weaker
story.月德的合神，作用和月德相近而稍弱: the partner of Monthly Virtue, working like it but a little weaker
story.與醫藥有緣，生病容易遇到好醫生，也適合醫護相關工作: a bond with medicine: when ill you tend to find a good doctor, and you suit work in healthcare
story.有領導力與威望，適合帶人、掌權: leadership and prestige, suited to leading people and holding power
story.聰明而孤高，有藝術、宗教、學術的天分，也比較享受獨處: clever and aloof, gifted in art, religion and scholarship, and fond of time alone
story.喜慶之星，逢之容易有婚嫁、添丁等喜事: the star of celebrations: it tends to bring weddings, births and other happy events
story.姻緣之星，逢之容易談戀愛或結婚: the star of love matches: it tends to bring romance or marriage
story.異性緣佳、有魅力；太多則要防感情糾紛: charm and many admirers; too much of it, and watch out for tangled love affairs
story.多情而有魅力，感情豐富，也容易為情所困: passionate and charming, rich in feeling, and easily troubled by love
story.奔波、遷移、出外之星，利於外出發展，也代表變動多: the star of travel and moving: good for making your way elsewhere, and a sign of much change
story.剛強果決、敢衝；過旺則衝動易惹是非，也要留意受傷與開刀: tough, decisive and daring; too strong, and impulsiveness stirs up trouble, so watch out for injuries and surgery
story.羊刃的對沖，要留意突發的意外與破耗: the clash of the Yang Blade: watch out for sudden accidents and losses
story.主突發的變化與損失，也代表行動力強: sudden changes and losses, but also a strong drive to act
story.心機深、城府重；用得好是謀略，用不好則容易是非: a deep, calculating mind; used well it is strategy, used badly it breeds trouble
story.要防意外與突發的災難: watch out for accidents and sudden misfortune
story.性格偏獨立、孤單，和親人或配偶聚少離多: an independent, solitary nature, often apart from family or spouse
story.感情上容易感到寂寞，和親人緣分較淡: prone to loneliness in love, with looser family ties
story.容易捲入是非、糾紛或官非: prone to getting caught up in gossip, disputes or legal trouble
story.又叫大耗，主破財、做事不順: also called the Great Waste: losing money and things not going smoothly
story.要留意血光，女命也要留意生產: watch out for injuries and bloodshed; for a woman, take care in childbirth
story.落空之意，所在的六親或事情容易有落空、不實的感覺: emptiness: the family members or matters it falls on can feel hollow or unreal
story.聰明果斷、個性剛強，有領導氣魄；運好則大富貴，運差則易受挫: clever, decisive and strong-willed, with the air of a leader; in good luck great success, in bad luck setbacks
story.婚姻感情上容易陰錯陽差、有波折: love and marriage prone to mix-ups and ups and downs
story.傳統上主婚姻不順，需要多經營感情: traditionally a bumpy marriage, so the relationship needs extra care
story.傳統上主祖業難守、理財要保守: traditionally family wealth is hard to keep, so manage money cautiously
story.上天赦免之日，一生遇難容易化解: the day heaven pardons: troubles in life are easily resolved
story.剛毅有魄力，喜火制伏；性格強而急: tough and bold, best tempered by Fire; a strong, impatient character
story.做事容易受阻、身不由己，凡事宜謹慎: often blocked and not your own master; be careful in all things
story.值太歲（本命年），一年裡變動較多，傳統上會去廟裡安太歲，凡事穩紮穩打: meeting Tai Sui (your own zodiac year): a year of more change; traditionally people make an offering to Tai Sui at the temple, and take everything step by step
story.太陽星照，容易得到男性長輩或上司的提拔: the Sun Star shines: older men or bosses tend to give you a lift
story.喪門星，傳統上要多關心家中長輩的健康，心情也容易低落: the Mourning Gate Star: traditionally, keep an eye on your elders' health; your mood may dip too
story.太陰星照，容易得到女性貴人的幫忙: the Moon Star shines: helpful women tend to lend a hand
story.官符星，要防口舌是非、合約與官司糾紛: the Lawsuit Star: watch out for gossip, contract disputes and lawsuits
story.死符星，傳統上主小病與不順，宜保守、多休息: the Minor Loss Star: traditionally minor illness and setbacks, so play safe and rest more
story.歲破（沖太歲），變動大，容易破財或搬遷，大事宜三思: the Year Breaker (clashing with Tai Sui): big changes, perhaps losing money or moving, so think twice before big decisions
story.龍德星，逢凶化吉，有貴人相助: the Dragon Virtue Star: bad luck turns to good, with helpful people beside you
story.白虎星，傳統上要防血光、意外與開刀，開車與運動要小心: the White Tiger Star: traditionally watch out for injuries, accidents and surgery, so take care driving and playing sport
story.福德星，福氣與財運都不錯: the Fortune Virtue Star: good blessings and good money luck
story.吊客星，傳統上要防親友的喪病之事，心情容易低落: the Mourning Guest Star: traditionally watch for illness or bereavement among family and friends; your mood may dip
story.病符星，要留意身體的小毛病，定期檢查: the Sickness Star: watch out for minor ailments and have regular check-ups
